about: Default values for every rule of thumb in the app. Each setting has a source and the date it was checked. A dateChecked of null means 'to be checked'. Percentages are stored as written (20 means 20%). On/off settings are true or false. Dates are stored as YYYY-MM-DD and shown as 17 Nov 2026.

settings.label: APA (Advance Provisioning Allowance) default
settings.note: Usually 25% to 40% of the charter fee. Covers fuel, food, drink, berthing and other running costs during the charter.

settings.label: Itinerary: default cruising speed
settings.source: Working rule. Use the yacht's own cruising speed when known.
settings.note: Used for new itineraries. Each itinerary can set its own speed.

settings.label: Itinerary: route allowance on estimated distances
settings.source: Working rule. Coastal passages round headlands can be 20% or more longer than the straight line.
settings.note: Added to the straight-line distance between two ports when the itinerary estimates a leg.

settings.note: Green on or under budget, amber when overspent by up to this %, red beyond it.
